correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts parity, b=1 divisor shapes, and all p-adic valuation ranges for odd b>=3. The high-valuation branch is eliminated by an exact 2-adic valuation identity for a geometric sum. Exact bounded verification found zero mismatches.

originality.rationale: The closest 2010 primary source gives the relevant sufficient constructions but not the converse. Current OEIS, exact/synonymous web searches, and the SCOPE archive did not reveal an equivalent support-{2,p} classification. The 1960 Sachs article remains a stated residual access risk. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The theorem closes the full two-prime-support case, proves that the odd-prime exponent can only be 1 or 3, and shows that the b=3 slice is exactly the Mersenne-cube family.
